card_arrival: An ordered card has not arrived, is delayed or appears lost in delivery.
card_linking: Link or connect an existing card to the app or account.
exchange_rate: Ask what currency exchange rate applies or how the rate is determined.
card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: The exchange rate applied to a card payment seems wrong.
extra_charge_on_statement: An additional or unexplained small charge appears on the statement.
pending_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal is still pending.
fiat_currency_support: Ask which fiat currencies can be held or supported in the account.
card_delivery_estimate: Ask the usual or expected delivery time for a card.
automatic_top_up: Set up, change or understand automatic account top-ups.
card_not_working: A physical card does not work, without a more specific payment, PIN or contactless issue.
exchange_via_app: Ask how to exchange currencies inside the app.
lost_or_stolen_card: A physical card has been lost or stolen; ask what to do or how to replace it.
age_limit: Ask the minimum age or age requirements for opening or using an account.
pin_blocked: A card PIN is blocked after attempts; ask how to unblock it.
contactless_not_working: Contactless or tap-to-pay with the card is not working.
top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Ask about a fee for topping up the account by bank transfer.
pending_top_up: A top-up is pending or has not completed yet.
cancel_transfer: Cancel an outgoing transfer, including one sent by mistake.
top_up_limits: Ask the minimum, maximum or frequency limits for adding money to the account.
wrong_amount_of_cash_received: An ATM dispensed a different amount of cash from the amount requested or charged.
card_payment_fee_charged: A fee or surcharge was charged for a card payment.
transfer_not_received_by_recipient: The recipient has not received an outgoing transfer that was sent.
supported_cards_and_currencies: Ask which external cards or card currencies can be used to top up.
getting_virtual_card: Ask how to get or create a reusable virtual card.
card_acceptance: Ask where, at which merchants or in which locations a card is accepted.
top_up_reverted: A top-up was reversed or returned to the funding card.
balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: An account balance does not reflect a cheque or cash deposit.
card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment is unfamiliar or unauthorized.
edit_personal_details: Change personal profile details such as name, address, email or phone number.
why_verify_identity: Ask why identity verification is required or why personal documents are needed.
unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification fails, is stuck or cannot be completed.
get_physical_card: Retrieve, locate or receive the existing card PIN. Despite this official label's name, its training examples concern getting the PIN.
visa_or_mastercard: Ask whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, or whether a network can be selected.
topping_up_by_card: Ask how to add money to the account using another bank card.
disposable_card_limits: Ask restrictions, availability, usage limits or merchants for disposable virtual cards.
compromised_card: Suspect stolen card details or a compromised card and ask how to secure it.
atm_support: Ask which ATMs accept the card or can be used to withdraw cash.
direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: An unfamiliar or unauthorized direct debit appears on the account.
passcode_forgotten: The app login passcode or password has been forgotten; ask how to recover access.
declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal was declined or rejected.
pending_card_payment: A card payment remains pending instead of completing.
lost_or_stolen_phone: A phone has been lost or stolen; ask how to protect or access the account.
request_refund: Ask how to obtain a refund for a card purchase or transaction.
declined_transfer: An outgoing bank transfer was declined or rejected.
Refund_not_showing_up: An expected or issued refund has not appeared in the account balance.
declined_card_payment: A payment made with the card was declined or rejected.
pending_transfer: An outgoing bank transfer remains pending or is still processing.
card_swallowed: An ATM retained or swallowed the physical card.
transaction_charged_twice: The same payment or transaction was charged twice.
verify_source_of_funds: Ask how or why to verify the source of money or funds.
transfer_timing: Ask normal transfer processing times or when a transfer should arrive.
reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted or reversed instead of completing.
change_pin: Change or reset the card PIN to a different number; distinguish it from retrieving the existing PIN and the app login passcode.
beneficiary_not_allowed: A transfer cannot be sent to a particular beneficiary or destination account.
transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged for sending a bank transfer.
receiving_money: Ask how to receive money from someone else or another account.
failed_transfer: A bank transfer failed or was returned, without a more specific decline, pending or beneficiary issue.
transfer_into_account: Ask how to add funds to this account through an incoming bank transfer.
verify_top_up: Ask how or why to verify a funding card or card top-up.
getting_spare_card: Get an additional or spare physical card while retaining the existing card.
top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Ask whether or how the account can be topped up with cash or a cheque.
order_physical_card: Ask how to order or obtain a physical card, including its price, delivery eligibility or an ordering problem.
virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card, including a disposable virtual card, does not work or cannot be used for payment.
wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: The currency exchange rate applied to an ATM withdrawal seems wrong.
get_disposable_virtual_card: Ask how to get or create a disposable or single-use virtual card.
top_up_failed: Adding money through a top-up failed or was rejected.
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: An incoming bank transfer does not appear in the account balance.
cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: An ATM cash withdrawal is unfamiliar or unauthorized.
exchange_charge: Ask about a fee or charge for exchanging currencies in the account.
top_up_by_card_charge: Ask about a fee or charge for topping up using another bank card.
activate_my_card: Ask how to activate a newly received physical card.
cash_withdrawal_charge: Ask about an ATM withdrawal fee, allowance or charge.
card_about_to_expire: A card is expiring or has expired; ask about renewal or replacement.
apple_pay_or_google_pay: Set up or use Apple Pay or Google Pay, including topping up the account through these wallets.
verify_my_identity: Ask how to verify identity or which documents and steps are needed.
country_support: Ask which countries or residency locations are supported for opening an account.
